574-1981-2415-7452.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-7452.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1432-1671-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-1671-2645-3430.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3430-3755-3812.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3430-3755-3812.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-4054--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-4054--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1818-1981-2415-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1306-4574-4659-6769-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
1306-4574-4659-6769-6842.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mana Crypt, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mana Crypt from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mana Crypt.
Repeat.

670-1619-4142-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6143.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Feywild Caretaker to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

4681-5170-5256-7452.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3259-3263-4478-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
3259-3263-4478-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-4478-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4907-5686-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
4907-5686-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

628-6798-7199.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1636-4474-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat

2438-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4136-4365-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4136-4365-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

232-1235-1809-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

104-2811-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2811-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-5078-5645-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

454-1978-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
454-1978-6478.description:
Cause Arbor Adherent to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

372-2493-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-2493-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2178-2292-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-2292-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Devil.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1768-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1768-4613-5507.description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Human token.
Repeat using the Human token instead.

Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Mirrormade by paying {1}{U}{U}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Tree of Tales.
Activate Mirrormade by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Mirrormade from the battlefield to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2067-2928-4196.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Embereth triggers.
Holding priority, cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Resolve the Court of Embereth trigger, creating a 3/1 Knight creature token, then dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of creatures you control.
Each opponent whose life total is less than or equal to the number of creatures you control loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

215-851-3003-4050-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eleven artifacts.
215-851-3003-4050-5176.description:
Cast Mycosynth Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Mycosynth Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

731-5076-5280.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience attached to Kederekt Parasite.
You control a red permanent.
731-5076-5280.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library and draw seven cards.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, draw seven cards, and exile Echo of Eons.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1349-2292-5239.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-2292-5239.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden .
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 7, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2390-4522.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to an opponent.
2390-4522.description:
Deal damage to an opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on itself.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Coalhauler Swine and to you, which does not reduce your life total below 1 due to Fortune Thief.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to each player, which again does not reduce your life total below 1.

570-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Faeburrow Elder.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-3525.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
